messages:
Alisha Chen: Quick GA gating sweep — we need explicit signoff on SLA windows, pricing tiers for pilot vs GA, docs checklist, oncall/runbooks, and monitoring dashboards. tagging owners: @Jordan (SLOs/telemetry), @Mike (runtime + fallback), @Sara (docs), @Kevin (support), @Priya (pricing). Please confirm scope and blockers.

Jordan Patel: For SLAs: are we settling on Hosted=99.9% monthly, Dedicated=99.95% monthly? Also need p95/p99 latency SLOs called out (token-level and response).

Mike Huang: Confirm Dedicated 99.95 is fine. We should also surface a latency SLO matrix per model class (small/medium/large) otherwise customers will expect same latency across all. Also we need auto-fallback rules for capacity.

Sara Lopez: For docs I'm planning pages: 1) SLA & SLO definitions, 2) Incident playbooks, 3) Onboarding checklist (pilot->GA), 4) Pricing FAQ. Can publish a public draft for internal review by Friday.

Kevin Brooks: Support needs a separate pager for capacity degradation vs correctness incidents. Also require a short runbook for model fallback and customer notification templates. Can run a training session Thurs 11:00.

Priya Nair: Pricing: proposing pilot bundle (3mo) with 25% discount + one-time burst credits. For GA tiers: pay-as-you-go + committed reservations for Dedicated. Need telemetry to validate $/token across routes before we finalize pricing. EOW deadline for commercial approval?

DevOps Bot: runbook created: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/ga-fallback (auto-generated). Checklist status: SLA doc draft created, monitoring dashboard scaffolded.

Jordan Patel: Telemetry note: we'll add token-level cost breakdown and per-route p95/p99 to console. ETA Tuesday EOD for data + dashboard wireframe.

Mike Huang: Putting a small sample config for model rollout + fallback to keep things concrete:
```json
{
  "rollout": "canary",
  "canary_fraction": 0.05,
  "fallback_policy": ["smaller-quantized-variant", "regional-fallback"],
  "slo_enforcement": {
    "p99_latency_ms": 1200,
    "availability_pct": 99.95
  }
}
```

Sara Lopez: Docs timeline: draft by Fri, internal review Mon, public-ready Wed next week. Will add a short "what customers should expect" section for pilot accounts.

Kevin Brooks: Support: I'll attach the playbook to the runbook link and add the notification templates. Training invite sent.

Priya Nair: I'll lock the pilot commercial terms once we have the initial telemetry slice (Jordan), but we can approve the 25% pilot discount in principle.

Alisha Chen: Ok — owners and deadlines: Jordan (telemetry + dashboard) Tue EOD, Mike (rollout config + fallback testing) Tue, Sara (docs draft) Fri, Kevin (training + playbook) Thurs 11am, Priya (pilot pricing signoff) EOW. If you agree react with :white_check_mark:. I will collect signoffs and escalate any gaps.

Jordan Patel: :white_check_mark:

Mike Huang: :white_check_mark:

Sara Lopez: :white_check_mark:

Kevin Brooks: :white_check_mark: (training invite accepted)

Priya Nair: :white_check_mark: (holding commercial pending telemetry)

Alisha Chen: Thanks — I'll prepare a consolidated signoff doc and send a final pre-GA checklist by tomorrow.
